ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded in IsoRim's 3D view and on IsoRimZ floors.
- 3D models for tanks, taps, drains, valves, the refinery, the pumpjack and deepchem - Valves show open and closed; the pumpjack's plunger moves in 3D; the refinery's fire burns in its chimney - With IsoRimZ: the pumpjack stays on the ground with no floor over it; no floor over the refinery; the rest works on any floor; add the VE Framework Pack for pipes across floors
Needs the latest IsoRim Waylith; older versions load without the models.
让 Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角和 IsoRimZ 的楼层上正常工作。
- 储罐、出料口、进料口、阀门、精炼厂、抽油机和深层化学物的 3D 模型 - 阀门显示开和关；抽油机的柱塞在 3D 中运动；精炼厂的火焰在烟囱口燃烧 - 配合 IsoRimZ：抽油机只能建在地面，上方不能有楼板；精炼厂上方不能有楼板；其余建筑可建在任意楼层；管道跨楼层需要 VE Framework Pack
需要最新版 IsoRim Waylith；版本较旧时也能加载，只是没有模型。
